text_block_list.text:
Air Groove didn't seem to be feeling well, 
so I brought her to the infirmary, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... You're far too 
overprotective.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's hard to work when you keep 
looking at me with such an anxious face...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You may leave. As you wished, I shall take 
a brief rest...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Where am I? I thought I was resting in 
the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Who's there!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text: Can't you tell by looking? I am yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text:
You still refuse to take your Trainer's 
advice to heart, as usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text:
You surely understand that what she said 
hit right on the mark.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you are right on the mark, 
leaning on and relying too much on my 
Trainer will not foster my growth."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text:
Being pampered and placing your trust in 
someone are two different things. If you 
believe in them, just rely on them 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is true, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text:
No "howevers"! If your pride causes a 
delay in judgment, that's precisely what 
will stunt your growth!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Just as you say. I suppose 
I can place a little more trust in you...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What on earth... was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? My body feels light...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That was certainly spot-on advice. I 
ought to thank them later."

Afterward, perhaps thanks to the rest, Air 
Groove's condition returned to normal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What a strange dream... To think I'd get 
lectured by myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, when you're the one on the 
receiving end of a lecture, it really does 
take a toll on you... *sigh*"
